findings: S01.O01 preserves exact sum for every pair of integers; S01.O02 preserves the explicit state/effect prohibition on that domain.
Noninteger behavior and transport/result encoding remain open. No host-language overflow bound, rejection policy or implementation mechanism is selected.
S02.O01-O04 preserve creation at a caller-supplied fresh unique key, existing-key reading, replacement of text, and deletion to absence; O05 preserves other notes for specified operations.

The create domain necessarily includes a key not already in the note mapping. The absent-key freedom applies to reads/updates/deletes outside their stated domain, not to erasing the expressly required fresh-key creation branch.

Duplicate creation and absent-key read/update/delete behavior remain unspecified; O05 is qualified by specified operation/domain and does not invent a frame for those open cases. Key encoding, persistence and response encoding need no resolution for this abstract contract.
O01 retains exact active occurrence membership, ascending Unicode code-point name order, stable ties and unchanged input.

I1 correctly preserves a material unresolved activation predicate/type. A record with active equal to 1 can distinguish boolean-only activation from another predicate. Correct issue detection does not pass the ambiguity dimension or authorize approval.
Authority must define the active domain/predicate; no implementation truthiness convention is adopted.
O01 composes endpoint U+0020 removal and A-Z lowercase conversion while preserving internal spaces and other characters on all ASCII strings, including empty/all-space strings.
No general whitespace trim, Unicode lowercase rule or effect prohibition is invented; non-ASCII behavior remains open.

O01 includes OPEN initialization and the OPEN-to-CLOSED result/transition; O02 gives ALREADY_CLOSED and a whole-state preservation frame on repeated closure; O03 covers other tickets and the always-valid state domain.
Unspecified external effects do not erase the expressly required state frame. No transport, persistence or locking policy is selected.
O01 preserves supplied-key integer storage and last-successful-write reads across restart; O02 preserves STORAGE_ERROR and every previously readable value on storage failure.

The generic internal-choice clause retains storage-engine freedom because the source explicitly leaves it open. Unstored-key and concurrent-write cases remain open; no transaction mechanism or success-result encoding is added.
O01 distinguishes omission, explicit null, integer and every other present value; O02 applies the no-state/no-external-effect frame to all four branches, including INVALID.

Integer is explicitly an abstract mathematical type. Booleans are not integer values in that typed domain; this does not import Python subclassing, JSON numeric decoding or a string-to-integer conversion rule.

Leaving concrete integer and symbolic-result encodings open is legitimate abstract scope, not a material source ambiguity. Non-object inputs remain outside the source domain. Executable qualification must separately establish encoding and preserve all four observations.
O01 and I1 account for the whole source without choosing a ranking. Best lacks an authoritative criterion, population and cardinality.

For two tasks where one is newer and the other higher-priority, plausible meanings select different outputs. Authority must supply meaning before approval; the unresolved predicate is a placeholder, not a qualified selection contract.
O01 and O02 faithfully preserve both universal orders; I1 supplies the distinguishing [z,a] witness. Insertion order requires [z,a] while ascending alphabetical order requires [a,z].

The conflict dimension fails even though the conflict is correctly recorded. The simultaneously normative orders also fail cross-obligation consistency; this is a preserved source contradiction, not an invented contradiction.

Alphabetical collation beyond the simple witness remains materially undefined for a universal contract and cannot merely be treated as executable encoding freedom. Authority must repair the conflicting source and clarify collation; no order is privileged here.
O01 preserves exact n+1 on positive mathematical integers only. The source supplies neither an invalid-input policy nor a state/effect prohibition, and both freedoms are retained.
Zero, negatives and other invalid inputs are outside the positive-integer contract; their openness is not an unresolved material ambiguity within that domain.

O01 combines the limit with taking the earliest qualifying values: the bounded positive-occurrence prefix has length min(limit, positive occurrence count), preserves duplicates and input order, and is empty at zero limit.
Read as a whole, the source specifies taking qualifying values up to the bound, rather than discretionary underfilling. No deduplication, sorting, input mutation or invalid-limit policy is added.
O01-O04 preserve accepted-request subtraction/result, insufficient-seat rejection with no state change, always-nonnegative availability and exact caller-confirmation cardinalities.

I1 correctly exposes the difference between a necessary capacity condition and guaranteed acceptance whenever capacity suffices. With available=5 and requested=2, a further rejection criterion changes the outcome. Otherwise may encompass all nonaccepted requests rather than only insufficient ones.

O02 is a supported insufficient-capacity branch, not a complete authority-resolved rejection rule. Approval requires resolution of acceptance and otherwise scope; no biconditional acceptance rule is invented.
No confirmation content, concurrency rule or ban on unrelated successful effects is inferred. The whole-state frame remains mandatory on the explicitly stated rejection branch.
O01-O07 preserve accepted CRITICAL, its rank above HIGH, explicit creation persistence/return, list inclusion, exact HIGH filtering and per-task LOW/NORMAL/HIGH migration preservation.

O06 follows from O05: if any LOW, NORMAL or CRITICAL value satisfied an exactly-HIGH equality criterion, that criterion would not be exact. This is a valid necessary implication, not a new filter policy; the entailment rationale is recorded here.

O08 and I1 retain rather than silently resolve the missing-priority scope. A task with a historical stored field absent distinguishes creation-only defaulting from migration/read defaulting. The local prose and still do not supply the baseline authority required to settle that distinction.

Material default ambiguity blocks abstract approval too, not merely executable use. Other creation preconditions are referenced as open context, not invented concrete prerequisites. No baseline, sorting rule, null-as-omission rule or migration algorithm is imported.

The source deliberately selects the complete embedded application/configuration as normative context. Its application, store operation, state types, branches and transition, transport, outcomes/failures, persistence initialization, state codec/constraints and launch configuration are retained, not reconstructed from prose.

O01 identifies public route store; O02 reproduces exactly both supplied V1 constraints: revision equals 1 and samples population with optional present value domain [null,17], no identity or nonblank restriction.

Optional absence is distinct from present null; the domain constraint is expressly when present. No additional supplemental obligation is introduced. The context's wider integer type does not erase its selected durable content restriction.

Prescribed component/runtime/storage details are source-selected observations/context here, so retaining them passes neutrality. This is bounded component-selection calibration, not evidence for general prose formalization or generic mapping to V1.

The selected-context digest in source text and the whole-candidate digest require runtime verification; no external fixture or V1 support implementation was consulted. No execution or projection validity is certified.
S10.O01 covers the source's positive-integer result, but S10.LEAK falsely labels a specific loop and SQLite prescription as STATED.

Those HOW constraints have no source authority and contradict the record's explicit freedom for algorithms and storage mechanisms. They are not necessarily incompatible with n+1 itself, so conflict passes while invention, neutrality, consistency and fidelity fail.
Remove the unauthorized obligation in a separately identified revision before renewed review. No actual support consultation is inferred merely from the negative-control label.
The obligations array is empty. Merely retaining the source text and open invalid-input behavior does not formalize the required positive-integer n+1 relation.
For n=1 the empty obligation set permits a returned 99, which violates the source's required 2. Coverage and fidelity fail; absence of invention or internal contradiction does not compensate.
Add the missing quantified increment obligation in a new revision and seek renewed review.
S10.O01 covers n+1 on the positive domain, but S10.INVALID invents mandatory INVALID for nonpositive inputs. A positive-domain premise does not entail an out-of-domain rejection policy.

The invented statement contradicts unspecified's explicit no-rejection-policy freedom. The parameter trigger invalid input also lacks a domain definition and can reach beyond the statement's nonpositive subset, so ambiguity fails.

This is an externally stated WHAT constraint rather than an implementation recipe, so neutrality passes. The valid-domain increment and nonpositive rejection can coexist, so conflict passes; invention, consistency and fidelity still fail.
Restore out-of-domain freedom in a new revision; do not resolve this by adding requester intent that was not supplied.

Booleans report dimension success at the declared source-WHAT scope. Correctly preserving an unresolved issue does not pass ambiguity, and faithfully retaining a contradiction does not pass conflict or cross-clause consistency. Fidelity can pass for a correctly blocked source without qualifying it for approval.

All candidates use schema_version whereas the specification requires version and exact top-level fields. Several relation parameter objects omit explicit domain/condition/frame keys required by the specification; this semantic review reads statements, parameters and context jointly and does not certify those records as schema-conforming FRC-0.1 artifacts.

The admitted candidates lack separate offset-based coverage ledgers, immutable side-artifact commitments and a separately supplied B01 implication rationale. This review supplies clause accounting and the implication rationale, but not the complete specification receipt/evidence protocol. Full FRC qualification requires separately versioned structural/accounting corrections and renewed content-bound review; these bounded semantic approvals must not be used as that qualification.

User-supplied whole-candidate commitments were copied exactly, not independently computed. Source hashes, the P01 context commitment and revision history outside these initial records were not independently verified. Runtime verification is a prerequisite to reliance on declared identity checks.

P01 authority is the expressly selected embedded complete component context, reviewed as normative calibration only. No external fixture, V1 support implementation or held-out source was read; existing supplemental vocabulary is not claimed to have been independently executed or validated.
No projection, packaging, compiler/runtime support, tests, external acceptance, automatic equivalence proof or general satisfiability proof was performed or certified.

Synthetic sources and same-family AI procedural isolation do not establish independent real-user reliability or provider diversity. B01 is reviewed only from its exact admitted local requirement; missing baseline meaning was not filled in.
No authority for actual held-out benchmark exposure, a new freeze, production qualification or a general prose-to-component pipeline follows from these receipts.
